shellCommands.command: curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | head -40 && echo "---ADD---" && curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3000/books --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Winter on Gethen." && echo "---HOME---" && curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ && echo "---JSON---" && cat data/books.json
node server.js > /tmp/books-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/books-server.pid; sleep 0.3; cat /tmp/books-server.log; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:3000/

set -e
curl -sS -D /tmp/add.hdr -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/books \
  --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" \
  --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" \
  --data-urlencode "notes=Winter on Gethen."
echo "ADD headers:"; cat /tmp/add.hdr
echo "HOME:"; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/
ID=$(node -e "const b=require('./data/books.json'); process.stdout.write(b[0].id)")
echo "DETAIL:"; curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/$ID"
curl -sS -D /tmp/fin.hdr -o /dev/null -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/$ID/finish"
echo "FINISH headers:"; cat /tmp/fin.hdr
echo "AFTER:"; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/
echo "JSON:"; cat data/books.json
echo "MISSING:"; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/nope
kill $(cat /tmp/books-server.pid) || true
